column4: EPIC-5: Integration Defects & Real Rasa Migration
column16:
WHY:
The end-of-Sprint-3 integration audit (docs/testing/sprint-3-integration-audit.md) ran all 8 services together and drove real conversations through the gateway. All unit suites pass, but core flows break at the service seams, and the three role packs are hand-written keyword matchers rather than Rasa. The team decided to (1) migrate the role packs to real Rasa Open Source 3.6 and (2) demo locally on laptop C instead of deploying to OCI/Vercel/Neon.

SCOPE:
- slice-32..40 (Tasks) close the audit defects (Bugs) listed under this epic.
- Every Bug carries a label naming the slice that fixes it.

DONE WHEN:
- All Bugs under this epic are verified fixed on laptop C.
- The demo script runs end-to-end on the local stack.

column4: slice-32-rasa-contract-v2
column16:
WHAT TO BUILD:
- ADR-006 — Rasa converse contract v2 (freeze on day 1). It must pin down:
  - - Request: POST RASA_<PACK>\_URL/webhooks/vario/converse with sender = conversation_id (one Rasa tracker per conversation), message, and metadata.auth_context = employee_id, full_name, role from the authenticated user — never from chat text.
  - - Response: the ADR-002 fields plus card (this turn's card payload or null) and sensitive_next_input (true when the next user message must be redacted, e.g. a security answer). slots carries only this turn's template values.
  - - How the custom Rasa input channel builds the response: intent/confidence from latest_message, active_loop → current_form, requested_slot → current_step, collected text and JSON messages → response_text / template_key / card / audit_event.
  - - Where dialogue state lives: Rasa SQL tracker store in the stack's Postgres (survives restarts); the gateway sessions row becomes a mirror.
  - - Examples for a form turn, a card turn and a degraded turn.
- Shared Rasa input channel module — one copy used by all three packs (mounted or copied at build; ADR decides), plus a contract test fixture packs and the frontend can test against.
- Gateway changes:
  - - Send conversation_id as sender and the identity in metadata.
  - - Store the session mirror exactly as returned (stop the endless slot merge).
  - - Persist each bot message's card (Alembic migration: JSON column on messages) and return it from /api/chat and message history.
  - - Skip the FR-2 clarification override while a form is active.
  - - Redact the next user message when sensitive_next_input was set (replaces the hard-coded IT form/step check).
  - - Rasa instance unreachable/erroring → HTTP 200 with a friendly role-pack-specific bot reply and degraded: true; keep the user's message.
  - - Unhandled 500s carry CORS headers.
  - - Enforce or remove sessions.expires_at (ADR decides).
- Update docs/api-contract.md for the new optional fields.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (convert to checklist in Jira):
- Given ADR-006 is merged, then it specifies the exact request/response JSON with examples for a form turn, a card turn and a degraded turn.
- Given any chat turn, then the role pack receives sender = conversation_id and metadata.auth_context.employee_id equal to the logged-in user's external_id.
- Given a turn whose response omits a key used in an earlier turn, then /api/chat session.slots does not contain the earlier value.
- Given a bot reply with a card, when the conversation history is fetched, then the same card is returned for that message.
- Given an active form and a low-confidence user reply, then the role pack's reply is returned (no clarification override).
- Given sensitive_next_input was true on the previous reply, then the user's next message is stored redacted, and the existing IT redaction tests still pass.
- Given a role pack is down, when a user sends a message, then the API returns 200 with a friendly degraded reply, the user message is persisted, and the response has CORS headers.
- Given an unhandled exception, then the 500 response includes CORS headers.
- Given the backend suite, then all tests pass and new tests cover each criterion above.

CLOSES BUGS (labelled slice-32-rasa-contract-v2):
- B5a: Session slots accumulate forever; every reply returns all past values
- M6: Role-pack outage returns HTTP 500, loses the user's message and has no CORS header
- N1: sessions.expires_at is written but never enforced

DEPENDS ON: Nothing — this slice goes first. ADR-006 must be merged on day 1, because slices 33, 35, 37 and 39 build against it.
DEV ENVIRONMENT: Tahir — laptop A (M1, 8 GB). Backend work runs natively; no Rasa needed (use the contract fixture).
HUMAN REVIEW: Yes — adds a DB migration and changes how the logged-in identity is passed to role packs.
SLICE DOC: docs/slices/slice-32-rasa-contract-v2.md

column4: slice-33-chat-ui-hardening
column16:
WHAT TO BUILD:
- Render every bot card from that reply's own card field — live and from history. Remove the slot-key sniffing and regex-on-text card detection in toThreadRow.
- Disable Confirm/Cancel/option buttons while a send is in flight and once answered; guard /home/new against double-create.
- Refresh the sidebar conversation list after creating a conversation and after each turn.
- Talk mode: detect insecure origins (window.isSecureContext) and explain; exit the overlay with a message on any speech-recognition error and on a failed send.
- Distinct error messages for rate limit (429), server error and network failure; mark a failed user message and offer retry.
- Show an "Admin console" link for admin roles.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (convert to checklist in Jira):
- Given an HR balance check followed by a WFH question and a leave request, then the WFH answer renders as text, the leave prompts show their options, and the confirmation shows Confirm/Cancel.
- Given an Admissions checklist followed by a status lookup, then the status lookup renders as a status card.
- Given any conversation, when the page is reloaded, then every card renders the same as it did live.
- Given a double-click on Confirm, then exactly one message is sent.
- Given the UI opened on http://<LAN-IP>:3000, when talk mode is started, then the user sees a "voice needs HTTPS or localhost" message instead of a stuck overlay.
- Given a speech-recognition error or a failed send in talk mode, then the overlay closes with a message.
- Given a 429, then the message tells the user to wait; given the backend is down, then it says the service is unavailable.
- Given a new conversation, then it appears in the sidebar without a reload.
- Given an admin login, then a link to /admin is visible.
- Given the Jest suite, then tests cover each criterion using ADR-006 contract-shaped fixtures.

CLOSES BUGS (labelled slice-33-chat-ui-hardening):
- B5b: Chat page picks cards from accumulated session slots, so stale cards replace later replies
- M12: Cards break after a page reload because card data isn't stored with the message
- M8: Talk mode gets stuck on 'Listening…' and doesn't detect insecure origins
- M10: Double-clicking Confirm or an option button sends the message twice
- M11: Sidebar conversation list never refreshes; admins have no link to the console
- N2: Every chat error shows 'Connection lost'; failed messages have no retry

DEPENDS ON: ADR-006 from slice-32 (start on day 1 against its fixtures).
DEV ENVIRONMENT: Tahir — laptop A. Frontend runs natively; use the ADR-006 fixtures, no Rasa needed.
HUMAN REVIEW: No.

column4: slice-34-local-demo-stack
column16:
WHAT TO BUILD:
- docker-compose.yml brings up the whole stack with correct ports, env, healthchecks and depends_on:
  - - postgres, gateway and frontend
  - - all four real mock services: auth, hrms, itsm and admissions
  - - rasa-hr, rasa-it and rasa-admissions on rasa/rasa:3.6.20-full, each with an action server (Python 3.10 + rasa-sdk 3.6.x)
  - - the Rasa tracker store on postgres
- One documented command trains all three models (models persisted). Compose fails clearly if a model is missing.
- Gateway start runs alembic upgrade head plus an idempotent seed. Stop using create_all on Postgres. The seed must not log DATABASE_URL.
- Frontend: Next.js rewrite /api/* → gateway; NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=/api. Only port 3000 needs to be reachable from other laptops.
- mock-auth: one employee login per presenter plus an applicant login. Agree the IDs with slices 36 and 38 so they exist in HRMS and ITSM.
- Rate limiting keyed by the forwarded client IP behind the trusted proxy (or per user), so four laptops behind one proxy/tunnel don't share the login limit.
- docs/demo/local-demo.md — runbook for laptop C:
  - - WSL2 memory (.wslconfig) and a Windows Firewall rule for port 3000
  - - Hotspot vs college Wi-Fi check
  - - Cloudflare quick tunnel for HTTPS and the microphone (cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:3000, no account)
  - - Chrome insecure-origin flag as a fallback
  - - Training the models and resetting data between rehearsals
  - - Demo accounts table and troubleshooting
- README rewrite: local run, ports, accounts.
- ADR-007 records the local-demo decision; mark the OCI/Vercel/Neon/Cloudflare-deploy references superseded.
- Fix references to the non-existent docs/vario-overview.md (the file is docs/overview.md).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (convert to checklist in Jira):
- Given a fresh clone on laptop C with .env from .env.example, when the documented train and docker compose up commands run, then every service reports healthy.
- Given the stack on laptop C, when a client on the same hotspot opens http://<C-IP>:3000, then login and one chat in each role pack work.
- Given the quick-tunnel URL, when it's opened on another laptop, then login, chat and the talk-mode microphone work.
- Given a fresh database, then migrations and the seed run automatically, and a second start doesn't duplicate data.
- Given four laptops logging in through the tunnel within one minute, then none is rate-limited.
- Given the README and the runbook, then a teammate can boot the demo without asking anyone.
- Given the compose file, then no secret values are hardcoded.

CLOSES BUGS (labelled slice-34-local-demo-stack):
- B1: docker compose does not run the real stack
- B3: Database is never migrated or seeded automatically, and seeding is undocumented
- B4: Frontend can't reach the API from other laptops (localhost baked into the bundle)
- N3: Rate limits break a multi-laptop demo (shared IP behind proxy, single demo account)
- N4: Docs describe the dropped cloud deployment and an unstarted project

DEPENDS ON: slice-32. Final verification needs the Rasa packs from 35/37/39 — start with the current services and swap the images in as each pack lands.
DEV ENVIRONMENT: Built by Tahir; verified on Mitesh's laptop C (Windows 11, i5-13th-gen HX, 24 GB, Docker Desktop) — the demo host. Pair with Mitesh for the final run.
HUMAN REVIEW: Yes — Docker Compose, environment variables and infra.

column4: slice-35-hr-real-rasa
column16:
WHAT TO BUILD:
- Replace the keyword matcher in rasa-hr/server.py with a Rasa 3.6.20 project:
  - - config.yml with a DIET pipeline and FallbackClassifier at threshold 0.4
  - - domain.yml with intents, entities, slots, responses and forms
  - - data/ with nlu, rules and stories — reuse and extend the existing YAML
- Action server (rasa-sdk 3.6.x, Python 3.10) in rasa-hr/actions:
  - - The HRMS adapter lives inside the pack (no ../backend import) and calls mock-hrms via MOCK_HRMS_URL.
  - - No hardcoded employee data.
  - - An HRMS outage gives a clear "HR system unavailable" reply.
- Identity: balance and leave submission use metadata.auth_context.employee_id. Employee IDs typed in chat are ignored for these intents.
- leave_request_form:
  - - Steps: leave_type (including annual), start_date, end_date, reason → confirm → submit → reference ID, plus an audit event that includes the employee ID.
  - - Validation: dates, end ≥ start, no past dates.
  - - Cancel/stop works at any step, and other intents can interrupt.
  - - Slots reset after submit or cancel.
- Responses for greet, goodbye and out-of-scope — no debug text.
- Use the shared channel from slice-32; return template_key/card per ADR-006.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (convert to checklist in Jira):
- Given EMP-1001 is logged in, when they ask "what is my leave balance?", then their balance card shows without asking for an ID.
- Given EMP-1001 types "leave balance for EMP-1042", then EMP-1001's own balance (or a polite refusal) is shown — never EMP-1042's.
- Given a leave request, then each step asks its question in words, accepts annual, rejects invalid dates with guidance, and confirm files the request for the logged-in employee with a reference ID and an audit entry.
- Given a completed or cancelled request, when a new one starts, then every question is asked again.
- Given an off-script reply at the confirmation step, then the bot re-asks; "cancel" exits at any step.
- Given "what is the travel reimbursement policy?", then the bot clarifies instead of answering with the leave policy.
- Given "hi" or "bye", then a proper greeting or goodbye is returned.
- Given mock-hrms is stopped, then the reply says the HR system is unavailable — no hardcoded numbers.
- Given rasa data validate and rasa test nlu, then validation passes, and the existing HR flow tests are ported to the new runtime.

CLOSES BUGS (labelled slice-35-hr-real-rasa):
- B6: HR ignores the logged-in employee: balance loops and leave submission always fails
- B7: Every leave-request question shows 'Sorry, I couldn't put together a response'
- B2a: HR pack imports backend code and silently serves hardcoded data when that fails
- M1a: A second leave request reuses the previous request's dates and reason
- M2a: Any user can read another employee's leave balance and file leave as them
- M3a: Leave form gets stuck after an off-script reply at the confirmation step
- M4a: Off-topic policy questions get the leave policy at 0.9 confidence
- M5a: HR replies with 'Intent greet acknowledged' debug text
- N5: Leave form rejects 'annual' and natural-language dates

DEPENDS ON: ADR-006 from slice-32 (start NLU/domain/forms on day 1; plug in the shared channel when it lands).
DEV ENVIRONMENT: Pavan — laptop B (M4, 8 GB, Docker). Run rasa/rasa:3.6.20-full (arm64 image exists) or a Python 3.10 venv with pip install rasa==3.6.20. Run only the HR pack locally; full-stack integration on laptop C.
HUMAN REVIEW: No — but the reviewer confirms the employee ID is never taken from chat text for balance or submission.

column4: slice-37-it-real-rasa
column16:
WHAT TO BUILD:
- Replace rasa-it/server.py with a Rasa 3.6.20 project (DIET + FallbackClassifier 0.4; use the existing nlu, domain, rules and stories as the base).
- Forms, with cancel and interruptions at any step:
  - - ticket_status_form (ticket_id)
  - - raise_ticket_form (category, description → confirm)
  - - reset_password_form (employee_id, security answer)
- Action server (Python 3.10, rasa-sdk pinned to 3.6.x) using rasa-it/actions/itsm_adapter.py. Remove the unused backend copy of the ITSM adapter.
- Keep what works:
  - - FR-13 duplicate suppression
  - - The reporter comes from metadata.auth_context
  - - The security answer is never stored: set sensitive_next_input when asking for it (ADR-006)
- Limit reset attempts per employee across restarts (e.g. lock out in mock-itsm after 3 failures).
- Put the ticket ID in the "ticket created" text. "check my ticket status" without an ID asks for one.
- Each lookup returns only its own result — never the previous ticket's status.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (convert to checklist in Jira):
- Given the ticket-ID prompt, when the user says "cancel" or asks something else, then the prompt ends or the new intent is handled.
- Given "Is my ticket still open?" or "status of the ticket I submitted", then it's classified as check_ticket_status.
- Given a lookup of one ticket then another (and with mock-itsm down), then each card shows only its own ticket or a clear error.
- Given 3 wrong security answers, then restarting the flow does not allow more guesses.
- Given a created ticket, then the reply text contains the ticket ID.
- Given an identical repeated request, then FR-13 still returns the existing ticket, and the security answer never appears in messages, sessions, responses or logs.
- Given rasa data validate, then it passes, and the existing IT tests are ported to the new runtime.

- M3b: Ticket-ID prompt traps the user; even 'cancel' is rejected
- M4c: Ticket status questions start a new ticket instead
- B5c: IT replies carry the previous ticket's status, so cards show the wrong ticket
- M2b: Password-reset retry limit resets when the flow restarts (unlimited guesses)
- N9: 'Ticket created' reply has no ticket ID; 'check my ticket status' reuses the last ID
- N10: IT pack runs on the wrong Python for Rasa, with unpinned deps and a duplicate adapter

column16:
FOUND IN: End-of-Sprint-3 integration audit (2026-10-29), docs/testing/sprint-3-integration-audit.md (defect B5a)
SEVERITY: Blocker    VERIFIED: reproduced by running the stack
FIXED BY: slice-32-rasa-contract-v2

STEPS TO REPRODUCE:
# Log in as emp1@org.example.com and open an HR conversation.
# Send "what is my leave balance for EMP-1042".
# Send "can I work from home?".

ACTUAL: session.slots on the WFH reply still contains total/casual/sick/earned and employee_id from the previous turn. The role packs also re-merge stored slots, so values from any earlier workflow leak into every later turn (this drives the stale-card bugs B5b/B5c and M1a/M1b).

EXPECTED: Each response carries only the current turn's values; workflow values are cleared when a workflow completes or is cancelled (Rasa tracker owns dialogue state per ADR-006).

WHERE: backend/app/services/session_manager.py:54-56 (merge, never delete)

column4: [M6] Role-pack outage returns HTTP 500, loses the user's message and has no CORS header
column16:
FOUND IN: End-of-Sprint-3 integration audit (2026-10-29), docs/testing/sprint-3-integration-audit.md (defect M6)
SEVERITY: Major    VERIFIED: reproduced by running the stack

STEPS TO REPRODUCE:
# Stop the rasa-hr service.
# Send any message in an HR conversation.

ACTUAL: 500 'Internal server error'. The user's message is not persisted (transaction rolled back). The response has no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, so the browser reports a network error and the UI shows 'Connection lost'.

EXPECTED: Friendly bot reply (e.g. 'The HR assistant is unavailable right now, please try again shortly'), user message kept, CORS headers present, degraded flag set (NFR reliability).

WHERE: backend/app/services/dialogue_router.py (\_post_to_rasa raises); backend/app/main.py (Exception handler runs outside CORS middleware)
